annotator_statement: Claude annotated from statements, quotes, sources and the schema only; no algorithm output, scores or development labels were consulted.

items.statement: --t1: T1 full head input (not bias corrected), requiring an absolute path.
items.quote:
--t1 <t1_path> T1 full head input (not bias corrected). Requires an
ABSOLUTE Path!
items.annotation_note: “绝对路径”属命令行用法，主条件是必需的 T1

items.statement: Optional T2 full-head input must be externally biasfield corrected when --no_biasfield is used.
items.quote:
*Optional* T2 full head input (must be externally biasfield
corrected when called with --no_biasfield). Requires an
ABSOLUTE Path!

items.statement: An optional binary lesion mask must be in the same space as the T1 input.
items.quote: Path to a binary lesion mask in the same space as the T1 input.
items.annotation_note: 可选输入；“与 T1 同一空间”只在提供病灶掩膜时适用。【待决定】若把条件性要求也算，可标 attr_equal(T1, mask; space)

items.statement: For --surf_only, the segmentation created by FastSurferVINN must already exist.
items.quote: --surf_only: Only run the surface pipeline. The segmentation created by FastSurferVINN must already exist in this case.
items.annotation_note: 仅在 --surf_only 模式下成立的前置步骤要求。【待决定】模式相关的条件是否计为可执行

items.statement: A segmentation without --tal_reg does not need a FreeSurfer licence.
items.quote:
A
segmentation without --tal_reg does not need one.
items.annotation_note: 说明不需要许可证，不是要求

items.statement: Docker runs of the surface module require --fs_license pointing to a FreeSurfer licence file.
items.quote:
Required for Docker when running surface module:

--fs_license: Path to FreeSurfer license key file
items.annotation_note: 许可证文件不是可执行程序，且只在 Docker 运行表面模块时要求

items.statement: Input conformation specifications are checked automatically; non-compliant images are conformed.
items.quote: These specifications are checked in the run_prediction.py script and the image is automatically conformed if it does not comply.
items.annotation_note: 方法自身行为（自动 conform）

items.statement: Keeping native image geometry is incompatible with the surface pipeline.
items.quote:
Output all images and segmentations in the native
--keepgeom image space with its image geometry (voxel size,
dimensions, orientation). This setting is not
compatible with the surface pipeline

items.statement: A GPU makes segmentation much faster.
items.quote: A GPU makes the segmentation much faster.

items.statement: --viewagg_device auto checks whether there is enough memory to run view aggregation on the GPU.
items.quote: By default, the program checks if you have enough memory to run the view aggregation on the GPU.

items.statement: Unless --ignore_fs_version is set, the program checks the FreeSurfer version and terminates if the supported version is not sourced.
items.quote:
--ignore_fs_version Switch on to avoid check for FreeSurfer version.
Program will terminate if the supported version
(see recon-surf.sh) is not sourced.
items.annotation_note: 要求加载受支持版本的 FreeSurfer；版本号未在引文中给出，不发明版本参数

items.statement: --qc_snap creates quality control images to simplify the QC process.
items.quote: --qc_snap Create quality control images in $SUBJECTS_DIR/$sid/qc_snapshots

items.statement: For images with tumors or other large lesions, review LIT-modified outputs before downstream use.
items.quote: review LIT-modified outputs before downstream use.
items.annotation_note: 目视复核，且只针对含肿瘤/大病灶的图像

items.statement: Without --no_cereb, CerebNet runs automatically whenever the segmentation module runs.
items.quote: Unless switched off by the --no_cereb argument, this module is automatically run whenever the segmentation module is run.

items.statement: Without --no_hypothal, HypVINN runs automatically whenever the segmentation module runs.
items.quote: Unless switched off by the --no_hypothal argument, this module is automatically run whenever the segmentation module is run.

items.statement: With --no_biasfield, HypVINN still runs but expects biasfields to be corrected externally.
items.quote: HypVINN does run but expects that biasfields are corrected externally.

items.statement: --no_surfreg skips surface registration, but sphere.reg is needed for cross-subject statistical analysis of thickness maps.
items.quote: sphere.reg will be needed for any cross-subject statistical analysis of thickness maps
items.annotation_note: 跨被试厚度统计需要 sphere.reg。【待决定】该句出现在 exceptions 字段且以下游分析为条件

items.statement: Renaming an output file can break a later step, since later modules and follow-up tools look for the default names.
items.quote:
Later modules
and follow-up tools look for the default names, so renaming an output can
break a later step.

items.statement: The input data file has each frame as a separate input.
items.quote: Path to input file with each frame being a separate input.
items.annotation_note: mri_glmfit 的输入是多被试拼接文件，类型体系中没有对应类型，不发明类型。【待决定】是否新增“拼接数据”类型

items.statement: Global design matrix specified with a FreeSurfer Group Descriptor File (FSGDF).
items.quote: Specify the global design matrix with a FreeSurfer Group Descriptor File (FSGDF).
items.annotation_note: FSGD 定义全局设计矩阵

items.statement: One or more contrast matrix files in ASCII text.
items.quote: Specify one or more contrasts to test. The contrast.mat file is an ASCII text file with the contrast matrix in it

items.statement: Surface-based smoothing requires --surf; otherwise the input is treated as a volume.
items.quote: If the data are surface-based, then you must specify --surf, otherwise mri_glmfit assumes that the input is a volume

items.statement: Data must be assembled by resampling each subject's data into a common space and concatenating subjects into a single file.
items.quote:
Resampling each subject's data into a common space.

Concatenating all the subjects' into a single file.
items.annotation_note: 要求各被试重采样到共同空间：属跨被试一致，现有 attr_equal 只表达跨文件一致，且引文未给出具体空间。【待决定】

items.statement: The same FSGD used with mris_preproc must be used, maintaining subject order.
items.quote: Same FSGD used as with mris_preproc. Maintains subject order!
items.annotation_note: 被试顺序一致：与开发集第 13 条同类，按建议性处理

items.statement: DODS is specified in the tutorial example and is the default.
items.quote: DODS is specified (it is the default).

items.statement: If data have not been cached, the same operations can be performed manually.
items.quote: In the case that you have not cached the data, you can perform the same operations manually using the two commands below.

items.statement: The completed GLM has its output subdirectory under the glm directory.
items.quote: When this command is finished the glm directory will contain a sub-directory called lh.gender_age.glmdir.

items.statement: There is a subdirectory for each specified contrast, named after the contrast matrix file without the .mtx extension.
items.quote: There will be a subdirectory for each contrast that you specify. The name of the directory will be that of the contrast matrix file (without the .mtx extension).

items.statement: mri_info can be run on the assembled data to find its dimensions.
items.quote: Run mri_info on lh.gender_age.thickness.10.mgh to find its dimensions:

items.statement: Temporary directories or log files starting with tmp may appear and can be ignored.
items.quote: You may also see some temporary directories (with names starting with tmp) or log files, which you can ignore.

items.statement: You cannot specify both --X and --osgm, and a contrast cannot be specified with --osgm.
items.quote: You cannot specify both --X and --osgm. A contrast cannot be specified either.

items.statement: Do not use --prune with --sim; instead run the non-sim analysis with --prune and pass the created mask to the simulation.
items.quote: Do not use with --sim. Rather, run the non-sim analysis with --prune, then pass the created mask when running simulation.

items.statement: A surface file to measure for -surface-vertex-areas.
items.quote: <surface> - the surface to measure

items.statement: An input metric file for -metric-stats.
items.quote: <metric-in> - the input metric

items.statement: Optional ROI metric file restricting which data are considered.
items.quote:
[-roi] - only consider data inside an roi
<roi-metric> - the roi, as a metric file

items.statement: Exactly one of -reduce or -percentile must be specified for -metric-stats.
items.quote:
Exactly one of
-reduce or -percentile must be specified.

items.statement: The percentile must be between 0 and 100.
items.quote: must be between 0 and 100

items.statement: The reduction operation must be selected from the documented allowed list.
items.quote: The argument to the -reduce option must be one of the following:

items.statement: The NMT v2 template and its accompanying matching CHARM dataset, obtained from the NMT download.
items.quote:
The CHARM is distributed with the NMT v2. The NMT v2 has several forms
and variants (based on symmetry/asymmetry, FOV and voxel size), and
for each of these there is an accompanying CHARM.
items.annotation_note: 软件发布包自带的模板和图谱，不是被试数据

items.statement: The NMT download also includes a CSV table file of the ROI labels, hierarchically organized.
items.quote:
the NMT download also includes a CSV table file of the ROI
labels, hierarchically organized
items.annotation_note: 软件发布包自带的标签表

items.statement: The CHARM is defined in the coordinates/space of the NMT v2 template.
items.quote:
This atlas is defined in the coordinates/space of the NMT v2
template
items.annotation_note: CHARM 定义在 NMT v2 空间：使用 CHARM 分区的数据须处于 NMT v2 空间。【待决定】也可视为图谱自身属性的描述（建议性）

items.statement: For each form/variant of the NMT (symmetry/asymmetry, FOV, voxel size), there is a matching CHARM dataset.
items.quote:
The NMT v2 has several forms
and variants (based on symmetry/asymmetry, FOV and voxel size), and
for each of these there is an accompanying CHARM.
items.annotation_note: 发布包内变体对应关系

items.statement: The -sym option is valid for the NMT v2 only; in other cases it is ignored.
items.quote:
Option is valid for the NMT v2 only--in
other cases it is ignored.

items.statement: The -overwrite option allows the script to remove a pre-existing NMT directory.
items.quote: -overwrite :allows the script to remove a pre-existing NMT directory

items.statement: AFNI uses zero-base counting, so CHARM Level 1 is volume "[0]" and Level 6 is volume "[5]".
items.quote:
CHARM Level 1 is volume "[0]" and Level 6 is volume
"[5]", because AFNI (like Python and C) use zero-base counting.
